The door slides open, with silhouettes in the dark hallway. The lights flash on, giving off enough light to see their faces, revealing that it is the Minister of Defense, Chang Wanquan, and two armed guards.

"You've done well Chang," A hunched Xi Jinping states. "Not that I'd expect anything less from you and your pupils."

"I was just following your orders to the fullest. We followed exactly what you wanted us to do to the stroke."

"And that I thank you. I feel that if I had let anyone else in on what the plan was, that there would've been mistakes in executing it out."

"I too, feel that it would've happened as well."

Xi straightens up and turns around to face Chang. He sees on his face that he has a question for him. "Now, what is it you want to ask me?"

Shocked, that the President knew that he had a question to ask, stuttered at first answering the question. "W-well, uh, I would like to know why you asked me to come here. Our mission was finished, no?"

"Ah yes, that was why I had you come here. Please forgive me. At my age and as president of China, you sometimes forget things due to worrying about the world stage and what the next line is."

"It's no problem at all sir." Chang said reassuring Xi.

"I have a question that I know only you can answer, as only you knew of this mission."

"Whatever it is Mr. President, I'll answer honestly."

"Are we able to seal the nuclear hatches of North Korea, only letting us be able to open them?"

Chang internally breathed a sigh of relief. "That will actually be rather easy. These specialists should be able to code a program allowing that to happen."

Xi stepped aside and watched as the specialists quickly created a GUI for controlling North Korea's nuclear missiles and military communication. As they stepped aside, Xi walked over to the computer, hunched over, and clicked the buttons. Hundreds of miles away, the doors that allow the light of day to shine in are locked, and now only China has the keys.

Chang looked at Xi as he rose from hunching over the computer. "So, was that all you had to ask?"

"No, I actually have one more question, and only you can answer this one."

Xi Jinping turned around and approached Chang Wanquan, stopping inches before him. He rested his hand on his shoulder, and tilted his head downwards. Chang, starting to get nervous, asked Xi, "W-what is the question, Mr. President?"

Xi talked quietly into his ear. "I've seen your moves the past few years. I've seen your plays. I know what your game plan is."

Chang realized the President was onto him.
